## Information
Brighten up your home this Christmas with these mains operated multi function TreeBrights by Premier Decorations. Specifically designed for Christmas trees, LEDs are spaced approximately 2.5cm apart on a green wire, giving three times as many bulbs per metre than regular lights. Easy to place with a 5m lead length from the UK 3 pin transformer to the first bulb. Switch through the 8 available functions by the press of a dual purpose button on the transformer. Button can be held in to activate and deactivate the 8 hours on 16 hours off timer function, timer is active when the button is illuminated. This set contains a built in memory chip which allows the previous setting to be remembered. Available functions static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade and twinkle flash. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, with an IP20 rated transformer that must be kept dry at all times. Not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye catching scenes.
